questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由概率密度的性质}\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}f(x)dx=1\text{得}\\&\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}f(x)dx=\int_{0}^{1}k\sqrt{x}dx=\frac{2}{3}kx^{3/2}|_{0}^{1}\Rightarrow k=\frac{3}{2}\,,\\&\text{由连续随机变量的分布函数}F(x)=\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}f(t)dt\text{得}\\&\text{(1)当}x<0\text{时，}F(x)=\int_{-\infty}^{t}0dt=0\,;\\&\text{(2)当}0\leq x<1\text{时，}F(x)=\int_{-\infty}^{t}0dt+\int_{0}^{t}\frac{3}{2}\sqrt{t}dt=x^{3/2}\,;\\&\text{(3)当}x\geq 1\text{时，}F(x)=\int_{-\infty}^{t}f(t)dt=\int_{-\infty}^{t}0dt+\int_{0}^{t}\frac{3}{2}\sqrt{t}dt+\int_{0}^{t}1dt=1\,.\\&\text{综上所述，得}\\&F(x)=\begin{cases}0,\qquad x<0\\x^{3/2},\qquad 0\leq x<1\,;\\1,\qquad x\geq 1\end{cases}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由概率密度的性质有} \quad \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty} f(x) dx = \int_{0}^{1} (ax+b) dx = 1 \,, \\&\text{求得} \quad 2a+2b = 1 \,, \\&\text{又由 } F(1) = \int_{-\infty}^{1} f(x) dx = \int_{0}^{1} (ax+b) dx = \frac{1}{4} \text{算得} \\&\quad \frac{a}{2} + b = \frac{1}{4} \,, \\&\text{联立解得} \quad a = \frac{1}{2} \,, \; b = 0 \,.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由概率密度函数的性质知，}\int_{-x}^{+x}f(x)dx=1,\quad\int_{-x}^{+x}Ae^{-|x|}dx=1,\\&\text{而}\int_{-x}^{+x}Ae^{-|x|}dx=\int_{-x}^{0}Ae^{\prime}dx+\int_{0}^{+x}Ae^{-x}dx\\&\quad\quad\quad\quad=Ae^{x}|_{0}^{+}+\left(-Ae^{-x}|_{0}^{+}\right)=A+A=2A\\&\text{或}\quad\int_{-x}^{+x}Ae^{-x}dx=2\int_{0}^{+x}Ae^{-x}|_{0}^{+}dx=-2Ae^{-x}|_{0}^{+}=\text{2A},\text{所以}2A=1,\text{即}A=1/2.\\&\text{从而}f(x)=\frac{1}{2}e^{-|x|},-\infty<x<+\infty,\text{又因为}F(x)=\int_{-x}^{x}f(t)dt,\text{所以}\\&\text{当}x<0\text{时，}F(x)=\int_{-x}^{x}\frac{1}{2}e^{-|x|}dt=\frac{1}{2}\int_{-x}^{x}e^{\prime}dt=\frac{1}{2}e^{\prime}|_{-x}^{x}=1e^{x};\\&\text{当}x\geq0\text{时，}F(x)=\int_{-x}^{x}\frac{1}{2}e^{-|x|}dt=\int_{-x}^{0}\frac{1}{2}e^{\prime}dt+\int_{0}^{x}\frac{1}{2}e^{-t}|_{-x}^{0}dt=\frac{1}{2}e^{-t}|_{0}^{x}=\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{2}e^{-x}+\frac{1}{2}=1-\frac{1}{2}e^{-x},\\&\text{从而}F(x)=\begin{cases}\frac{1}{2}e^{x},&x<0\\1-\frac{1}{2}e^{-x},x\geq0\end{cases}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{随机变量}\lambda \text{的概率密度为}\\&f(x)=\frac{1}{2}e^{-|t|}(-\infty < x < +\infty)=\begin{cases}\frac{1}{2}e^{-x},\; x \geq 0\\1\\ \frac{1}{2}e^{x},\; x < 0\end{cases},\\&\text{由连续型随机变量分布函数}F(x)=\int_{-\infty}^{x}f(t)dt\text{得}\\&(1)\text{当}x<0\text{时，}F(x)=\int_{-\infty}^{x}\frac{1}{2}e^{t}\,dt=\frac{1}{2}e^{x},\\&(2)\text{当}x \geq 0\text{时，}F(x)=\int_{-\infty}^{x}\frac{1}{2}e^{t}\,dt+\int_{0}^{x}\frac{1}{2}e^{-t}\,dt=\frac{1}{2}+(-\frac{1}{2}e^{-t})|_{0}^{x}=1-\frac{1}{2}e^{-x}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&P\{X\leq 0.5\}=\int_{-\infty}^{0.5}f(x)dx=\int_{-\infty}^{0}0dx+\int_{0}^{0.5}2xdx=x^{\frac{1}{0.5}}\Big|_{0}^{0.5}=0.25,\\&P\{X=0.5\}=P\{X\leq 0.5\}-P\{X<0.5\}\,=\,\int_{-\infty}^{0.5}f(x)dx-\int_{-\infty}^{0.5}f(x)dx=0.\\&\text{当}X\leq 0\text{时，}F(x)=0;\\&\text{当}0<x<1\text{时，}F(x)=\int_{-\infty}^{x}f(t)dt=\int_{-\infty}^{0}0dt+\int_{0}^{x}2tdt=\hat{F}_{|0}^{x}=x^{2};\\&\text{当}X\geq 1\text{时，}F(x)=\int_{-\infty}^{x}f(t)dt=\int_{-\infty}^{0}0dt+\int_{0}^{x}2tdt+\bigl|\int_{0}^{t}0dt=t\bigl|_{0}^{1}=1,\text{故}\\&\qquad F(x)=\{\begin{array}{l}0,\ x\leq 0\\x^{2},\ 0<x<1.\\1,\ x\geq 1\end{array}\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}F(-\infty) &= 0 = A - \frac{\pi}{2}B, \ F(+\infty) = 1 = A + \frac{\pi}{2}B, \ \text{故} \, A = \frac{1}{2}, \ B = \frac{1}{\pi} \,. 1) \, P\{-1 < X < 1\} &= P\{-1 < X \leq 1\} = F(1) - F(-1) \\&= \left(\frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{\pi} \arctan x \right)\Bigg|_{-1}^{1} = \frac{1}{4} - \left(-\frac{1}{4}\right) = \frac{1}{2} \,. 2) \, f(x) &= F'(x) = \frac{1}{\pi(1+x^2)} \, , \ \ -\infty < x < +\infty \, .\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由概率密度函数的性质知，}\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}f(x)dx=1,\ \text{即}\ \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}Ae^{-|t|}dx=1,\\&\text{而}\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}Ae^{-|t|}dx=\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}Ae^{t}dx+\int_{0}^{+\infty}Ae^{-x}dx=Ae^{0}|_{-\infty}^{0}+\left(-Ae^{-x}|_{0}^{+\infty}\right)=A+A=2A\\&\text{或}\ \ \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}Ae^{-x}dx=2\int_{0}^{+\infty}Ae^{-x}dx=-2Ae^{-x}|_{0}^{+\infty}=2A,\ \text{所以}2A=1,\ \text{即}A=1/2.\\&\text{从而 }f(x)=\frac{1}{2}e^{-|t|},-\infty<x<+\infty,\ \text{又因为}F(x)=\int_{-\infty}^{x}f(t)dt,\ \text{所以}\\&\text{当}x<0\text{时，}F(x)=\int_{-\infty}^{x}\frac{1}{2}e^{-|t|}dt=\int_{-\infty}^{x}\frac{1}{2}e^{t}|_{-\infty}^{x}dt=\frac{1}{2}e^{t}|_{-\infty}^{x}=\frac{1}{2}e^{x};\\&\text{当}x\geq0\text{时，}F(x)=\int_{-\infty}^{x}\frac{1}{2}e^{-|t|}dt=\int_{-\infty}^{0}\frac{1}{2}e^{t}dt+\int_{0}^{x}\frac{1}{2}e^{-t}dt=\frac{1}{2}e^{0}|_{-\infty}^{x}-\frac{1}{2}e^{-t}|_{0}^{x}=\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{2}e^{-x}+\frac{1}{2}=1-\frac{1}{2}e^{-x},\\&\text{从而}F(x)=\begin{cases}\frac{1}{2}e^{x},&x<0\\&.\\1-\frac{1}{2}e^{-x},x\geq0\end{cases}\\&\text{当}x\geq0\text{时，}F(x)=\int_{-\infty}^{x}\frac{1}{2}e^{-|t|}dt=\int_{-\infty}^{0}\frac{1}{2}e^{t}dt+\int_{0}^{x}\frac{1}{2}e^{-t}dt=\frac{1}{2}e^{0}|_{-\infty}^{x}-\frac{1}{2}e^{-t}|_{0}^{x}=\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{2}e^{-x}+\frac{1}{2}=1-\frac{1}{2}e^{-x},\\&\text{从而}F(x)=\begin{cases}\frac{1}{2}e^{x},&x<0\\&.\\1-\frac{1}{2}e^{-x},x\geq0\end{cases}\end{aligned}

options.label: C

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{当}x\leq 0\text{时，}\ F(x)=\int_{-x}^{x}0dt=0;\\&\text{当}0<x\leq 1\text{时，}\ F(x)=\int_{-x}^{x}f(t)dt=\int_{-x}^{0}0tdt+\int_{0}^{x}tdt=\frac{1}{2}x^{2};\\&\text{当}1<x\leq 2\text{时，}\ F(x)=\int_{-x}^{x}f(t)dt=\int_{-x}^{0}0dt+\int_{0}^{1}tdt+\int_{1}^{x}(2-t)dt=0+\frac{1}{2}+\left(2t-\frac{1}{2}t^{2}\right)\Bigg|_{1}^{x}=-1+2x-\frac{x^{2}}{2};\\&\text{当}x>2\text{时，}\ F(x)=\int_{-x}^{0}0dt+\int_{0}^{1}tdt+\int_{1}^{x}(2-t)dt+\int_{2}^{x}0dt=1,\\&\text{故}\quad F(x)=\left\{\begin{array}{cl}0,\qquad x\leq 0\\ \frac{1}{2}x^{2},\qquad 0<x\leq 1\\ \\ -1+2x-\frac{x^{2}}{2},\quad 1<x\leq 2\\ \\ 1,\qquad x>2\end{array}.\right.\end{aligned}
